d: This role will be based in Qatar and will report to the General Manager MENA Talabat Kitchens. We are looking for a highly-driven and motivated Country Manager - Food Services for our team in Qatar. The ideal candidate will have a track record managing teams, comfortable working independently and handling data, whilst working closely with the management team.
q: li
Bachelor/MBA degree in Business, Marketing or STEM disciplines from a top university
li
3+ years of experience in a growth/product manager role or equivalent; in consulting; in internal strategy; or in startups
li
Prior experience in tech, e-commerce, food, FMCG or a mix of these industries required
li
A fluent Arabic speaker is mandatory
li
Previous experience managing cross-functional teams is mandatory
li
Deep understanding of financial statements, planning, and investment proposals
li
Understanding of analytical tools such as SQL, Tableau, and of course, Microsoft Excel
li
Ability to identify key metrics of success, digest complex data sets, and build data-driven action plans to respond to market conditions
li
Good knowledge of online marketing concepts and tools
li
Comprehensive knowledge of cloud kitchens industry and the restaurant business in general
li
Good communication skills, including the ability to present persuasive business cases to stakeholders at all levels of the organisation including C-Suite
r: Create blueprint for growing cloud kitchens’ presence in Qatar, closely aligned with the wider company strategy.
Accountable for Business Development, Stakeholder and wide-scale project management initiatives for Talabat Kitchens.
Owner of Food Services country financial statements, responsible for hitting budgets and ensuring growth initiatives across construction, new brand launches and running a profitable business.
Coordinate between multiple stakeholders and ensure the delivery of perfect orders to consumers
Partner with our Logistics Operations and Customer Experience teams to improve our overall site performance
Work closely with the Senior Director Food Services to create compelling business cases for future endeavors
Play a key role by jointly identifying kitchen spaces for expansion that meet all of the jointly defined criteria; location, size, accessibility, cost, etc.
Manage the day-to-day operations of multiple brands; meeting health & safety standards, managing stock deliveries, site hygiene, etc.
x: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
